desc:
🔧 Run your own PC repair shop!

Customers walk in with broken computers. Find out what's wrong, open them up on your workbench and fix them: swap dead parts, drive in the screws, plug in the cables, then power on and run a benchmark. Get it working and they pay you.

🖥️ 192 parts: graphics cards, CPUs, motherboards, RAM, liquid coolers, fans and cases
🛠️ Build custom PCs, dual-GPU workstations and whole server racks to order
🧹 Blow out dusty PCs, repaint cases, straighten bent CPU pins and clean off viruses
🏪 Decorate your shop and give it a new shopfront, with your name over the door in 3D
📦 Order parts and unpack the deliveries yourself
👷 Hire staff, build new floors and take on contracts
🌦️ Weather rolls in over the street while you work

Start with an empty unit and grow it into the best shop on the street!
